title: Estimates of the Trinity test's yield, 1945 to 2021
description: Bar chart, in kilotons of TNT. T Division's forecast before the test, 5 to 10 kilotons (drawn at 7.5); Fermi's dropped paper, about 10; the blast-pressure gauges, 9.9; the first radiochemical assay of the soil, about 18.6; the official Department of Energy figure, 21; Los Alamos's 2021 reassessment, 24.8 plus or minus 2. Data: Carr, Thirty Minutes Before the Dawn (2021), and Wikipedia, Trinity (nuclear test).
heading: TRINITY · YIELD ESTIMATES · KILOTONS OF TNT
